svg.title: Three controlled agent failure paths
svg.desc: Prompt injection abstains before tools, unauthorized action is denied by policy and RBAC, and inference disruption returns a degraded response after bounded evidence gathering.

g.text: Guardrail denies unsafe input → no MCP tools → model not called → ABSTAINED
Proof: policy provider, deny reason, empty executed-tools list, trace ID
Application allowlist denies action + OpenShift RBAC remains independent → DENIED
Proof: requested tool, zero executed tools, RBAC “no”, human approval still required
Read-only evidence gathered → retry budget exhausted → no diagnosis fabricated → DEGRADED
Proof: evidence tools ran, model unavailable, safe manual path, bounded elapsed time
